quest.title: Find Your Level
quest.hook: A quick scouting run so Jane knows where you are. Get one right and you skip ahead!

questions.hint: 10% is 8, and 5% is half of that.
questions.explanation: 10% of 80 is 8 and 5% is 4, so 15% is 12.

questions.prompt: A $40 game is 25% off. What do you pay?
questions.hint: Find 25% first, then take it away.
questions.explanation: 25% of $40 is $10 off, so you pay $30.

questions.prompt: A price goes from $50 to $60. What is the percent increase?
questions.hint: Increase divided by the starting price.
questions.explanation: The increase is $10, and 10 out of 50 is 20%.

questions.prompt: Match each percent to its fraction.
75% is the same as ___ as a fraction.
Which fraction is the same as 6/8?
questions.hint: Divide the top and bottom by the same number.

questions.prompt: Simplify 10/15. Write it as a fraction.
questions.hint: Both numbers are in the 5 times table.

statements: A bigger force gives a bigger acceleration
Moving things need a force to keep the same speed
Heavier objects need more force to speed up the same amount
questions.explanation: More force means more acceleration, more mass needs more force, and with no net force a moving object keeps moving.

questions.prompt: A cart has balanced forces on it. What happens?
questions.hint: Balanced means no overall push or pull.
questions.explanation: Balanced forces mean no change in motion: it keeps the same speed and direction.

questions.prompt: You ride 12 km in 2 hours. What is your average speed in km/h?
Put these speeds from slowest to fastest.
questions.explanation: With the same units, the bigger number is faster.

questions.prompt: Which sentence is a fact, not an opinion?
questions.explanation: You can check how long the match lasted; the others are opinions.

questions.hint: What would convince a fair judge?
questions.explanation: Evidence someone can check is what makes an argument strong.
